units.source_text: 这一天他西殿也不去，只是闭门独坐，闲眺沉思，寂寞地过了一日。

en.t: That day he did not even go to the west wing; he simply shut himself in, sat alone, gazed out idly and sank into thought, passing the day in loneliness.

units.source_text: 更哪堪六条妃子旅途漫漫，怅望长空，不知何等伤心落魄也！

en.t: And how much harder it was to bear that Lady Rokujo was on such a long journey, looking wistfully into the vast sky, surely desolate and heartbroken beyond measure!
